name: devradar-qa
description: Unified BDD test runner for DevRadar (omnistackJS) — orchestrates backend, web, and mobile suites and produces one merged report. Place this whole folder at repo-root/qa, alongside repo-root/backend, repo-root/web, and repo-root/mobile.

scripts.test:mobile: echo 'Mobile E2E requires a simulator/emulator or Maestro CLI — run manually or via the nightly CI job, see docs/06-framework-selection.md §5' && npm run maestro --workspace=mobile-tests
scripts.test:smoke: npm run test:backend:smoke && npm run test:web:smoke
scripts.test:regression: npm run test:regression --workspace=backend-tests && npm run test:regression --workspace=web-tests
